constraints.name: appointment_item_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((employee_id IS NULL) AND (workstation_id IS NULL) AND (planned_start_at IS NULL) AND (planned_end_at IS NULL)) OR ((employee_id IS NOT NULL) AND (workstation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (planned_start_at IS NOT NULL) AND (planned_end_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: appointment_item_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['requested'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying])::text[])) OR ((employee_id IS NOT NULL) AND (agreed_price IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: appointment_item_employee_id_service_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (employee_id, service_id) REFERENCES employee_service(employee_id, service_id)

constraints.name: appointment_item_state_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['requested'::character varying, 'scheduled'::character varying, 'in_progress'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying, 'no_show'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: no_employee_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (employee_id WITH =, tstzrange(planned_start_at, planned_end_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['scheduled'::character varying, 'in_progress'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: no_pet_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (pet_id WITH =, tstzrange(planned_start_at, planned_end_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['scheduled'::character varying, 'in_progress'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: no_station_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (workstation_id WITH =, tstzrange(planned_start_at, planned_end_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['scheduled'::character varying, 'in_progress'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: no_shift_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (employee_id WITH =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&)

constraints.name: inventory_movement_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((movement_kind)::text = 'receipt'::text) AND (quantity_delta > (0)::numeric)) OR (((movement_kind)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['use'::character varying, 'waste'::character varying])::text[])) AND (quantity_delta < (0)::numeric)) OR ((movement_kind)::text = 'adjustment'::text)))

constraints.name: inventory_movement_movement_kind_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((movement_kind)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['receipt'::character varying, 'use'::character varying, 'waste'::character varying, 'adjustment'::character varying])::text[])))
